note: Lassen NF campground in mixed conifer forest on Hwy 36, 14 miles west of Chester and about 14 miles from Lassen Volcanic's southwest entrance; open early summer into fall. Parking is limited within the campground. --Claude
summary: Gurnsey Creek (Lassen NF): FS page + rec.gov group listing + imagery. Keep. Individual sites first-come at $14 (rate filled), group loops 31-51 reservable only as groups; vault toilets, drinking water, 14-day limit. No rig length stated; season unstated beyond 'early summer into fall'.
flags: FIT: no rig length stated anywhere read; 'Parking is limited within the campground'. rec.gov's group units list Max Vehicle Length 60 ft. Inclusion stands on 'RVs/Boats' in the site rules.
SEASON: 'Generally open early summer into fall' - no dates; group reservation season 05-22..10-05. Left unset. FS shows 'Site Open' on 2026-11-26, likely stale for late November - no status written.
WEBSITE: stored FS + rec.gov (group-only listing) fine; the rec.gov link books groups only.
PIN: stored 40.30906,-121.42820 is the entrance on Hwy 36 (FS GPS 40.30889,-121.42667 is inside the camp, ~130 m) - fine.
